perks.name: Assault Mag
perks.desc:
This shotgun's magazine is optimized for quick combat.
  •  Greatly increases stability
  •  Increases rate of fire

perks.name: High-Caliber Rounds

Shots from this weapon knock the target back farther.
  •  Slightly increases range

perks.name: Dynamic Sway Reduction
perks.desc: Improves accuracy and stability while continuously holding down the trigger.

perks.name: Keep Away
perks.desc: Increases reload, range, and accuracy when no targets are in close proximity.

perks.name: Slice
perks.desc: Casting your class ability allows this weapon to sever targets on hit for a brief duration, up to a maximum number of targets.

perks.name: Tear
perks.desc: Precision final blows cause nearby targets to become severed.

perks.name: Zen Moment
perks.desc: Causing damage with this weapon reduces recoil and flinch over time.

perks.name: Enlightened Action
perks.desc: Dealing damage improves reload speed and handling.

perks.name: Rewind Rounds
perks.desc: When this weapon's magazine is empty, it refills from reserves based on the number of hits.

perks.name: Discord
perks.desc: Final blows with another weapon grant this weapon increased speed for aiming down sights, accuracy, and airborne effectiveness for a short time. When Discord is active, final blows refund ammo.

perks.name: Elemental Capacitor
perks.desc:
Increased stats based on the currently equipped Super.
• [Solar] increases your reload speed.
• [Arc] increases handling.
• [Void] increases stability.
• [Stasis] moderately controls recoil and increases movement speed when aiming down sights.
• [Strand] increases airborne effectiveness.

perks.name: Target Lock
perks.desc: Damage increases the longer this weapon remains on a target.

perks.name: Onslaught
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon increase its rate of fire.

perks.name: Hatchling
perks.desc: Precision final blows or rapidly defeating targets with this weapon spawns a Threadling at the target's location.

perks.name: Rampage
perks.desc: Kills with this weapon temporarily grant increased damage. Stacks 3x.

perks.name: One for All
perks.desc: Hitting three separate targets increases damage for a moderate duration.

perks.name: Tap the Trigger
perks.desc: Grants a short period of increased stability and accuracy on initial trigger pull.

perks.name: Desperate Measures
perks.desc: Weapon final blows grant bonus damage. Melee and grenade final blows grant a larger damage bonus that can stack.

perks.name: Collective Action
perks.desc:
Collecting an Elemental pickup or destroying a Tangle grants this weapon a stacking period of increased damage. Throwing a Tangle provides additional time.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.

perks.name: Attrition Orbs
perks.desc: Dealing sustained damage creates an Orb of Power.

perks.name: Skulking Wolf
perks.desc: While at low health, final blows with this weapon grant enhanced radar, remove you from opposing Guardians' radar, and make combatants less aggressive toward you.

Inspired by @PodvsEnemies Podcast vs Enemies episode 93 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/0uYGSQqlyX1faCyATCDuno?si=IMSCRgTRQr-_THJdjxFMIQ) with @ImpetusAlways and @Saint_Kabr. First-choice PvE pick for add-clearing Minor spec enemies in end-game content, particularly for Strand subclasses. Lethal Abundance has decent stats, but as a High-Impact frame auto rifle this isn't going to be on too many people's wish list. as a subfamily, they generally have poor handling and reload speed, so that's what to boost in the barrel and mag perk slots. For Strand synergy, Slice and Hatchling in the two trait columns give you the two perks to work with using your aspects and fragments. Slice also makes this a good swap weapon in a Bait and Switch rotation, applying 40% reduction in damage output from affected targets when procced after using your class ability. Recommended MW: Stability, with a damage boosting (Minor or Taken Spec) mod.

Inspired by @PodvsEnemies Podcast vs Enemies episode 93 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/0uYGSQqlyX1faCyATCDuno?si=IMSCRgTRQr-_THJdjxFMIQ) with @ImpetusAlways and @Saint_Kabr. First-choice PvE pick for add-clearing Minor spec enemies in general content, particularly for Strand subclasses. Lethal Abundance has decent stats, but as a High-Impact frame auto rifle this isn't going to be on too many people's wish list. as a subfamily, they generally have poor handling and reload speed, so that's what to boost in the barrel and mag perk slots. In the first trait column, Slice is useful when facing tankier enemies, applying 40% reduction in damage output from affected targets when procced after using your class ability, which also makes this a good swap weapon in a Bait and Switch rotation. Alternatively, Enlightened Action boosts both handling and reload speed just for hitting a target. Pairing that with Onslaught in the second trait column should help mow through groups of minor spec adds. Recommended MW: Stability, with a damage boosting (Minor or Taken Spec) mod.

pandapaxxy (PvE / Controller / M+KB): "Lethal Abundance has one thing going for it, being a Strand high-impact frame auto rifle. Slice and Hatchling both give this weapon extra Strand utility, but on other subclasses this weapon feels like any generic high-impact auto rifle. Enlightened Action and Keep Away both bump up your reload speed, either organically or passively, respectively. Target Lock works best on beefier targets, but can also help on rank and file enemies. Hatchling works best when paired with Strand. Onslaught might be the best neutral perk, but if you want a faster firing auto rifle, just use any of the other Strand auto." Recommended MW: Handling.

pandapaxxy (PvP / Controller): "Lethal Abundance might have a better place in PvP with great neutral buffs like Tap the Trigger paired with Keep Away. Dynamic Sway Reduction can also tighten up the firing pattern. Slice is looking like the best option for most players in the third column, so having a bit of added stability or better lethality will depend on the players." Recommended MW: Stability.
